description: When Shera opened her eyes, she was surprised for a moment, not just because she was alive, but because of the change in her... The fate of her companions no longer concerned her and her powers were no longer the same. And suddenly she became aware of the emptiness inside her. She no longer felt anything. She travelled, crossing incredible worlds she had never suspected the existence of, without any of it inspiring the least interest in her. She killed, cut short lives, and spread the Corruption flawlessly, doing what had to be done in obedience to a will that was no longer her own.
summon: I have been reborn, changed, in this world. Corrupted.
